key_debates.title: Is supplier-financed negative working capital durable? / 供应商融资支持的负营运资金是否可持续？

key_debates.resolution_kpi_or_event: Accounts-payable-to-inventory remains near the disclosed level while inventory growth does not materially exceed sales growth and normalized FCF is at least USD 1.94 billion. / 应付账款占库存比例维持在披露水平附近、库存增速不显著高于销售增速，且标准化FCF至少19.4亿美元。

scenarios.key_driver: Gross-margin pressure persists, capex remains elevated and supplier-finance support normalizes, reducing cash conversion. / 毛利率压力持续、资本开支维持高位且供应商融资支持正常化，现金转化下降。
scenarios.falsification_trigger: LTM FCF exceeds USD 1.70 billion while payable support and revolver capacity remain stable. / 若LTM FCF超过17亿美元且应付账款支持与循环授信能力保持稳定，则Bear情景被推翻。
scenarios.notes: USD 1.30 billion is a 20.4027% decline from the validated base; 20x is an analyst downside multiple, not a peer-derived fact. / 13亿美元较已验证基准下降20.4027%；20倍为分析师下行倍数，并非同业事实。

scenarios.name: Base
scenarios.key_driver: Sales growth continues, supplier terms remain broadly stable and growth capex produces modest incremental FCF. / 销售持续增长、供应商条款大体稳定，增长性资本开支带来温和增量FCF。
scenarios.falsification_trigger: FCF falls below USD 1.50 billion or net debt and supplier-finance dependence rise without proportional cash growth. / 若FCF低于15亿美元，或净债务与供应商融资依赖上升而现金流未同比例增长，则Base情景被推翻。
scenarios.notes: USD 1.70 billion is 4.0887% above the validated LTM base; 25x is the disclosed reverse-valuation reference. / 17亿美元较已验证LTM基准高4.0887%；25倍为已披露的反向估值参考。

scenarios.name: Bull
scenarios.key_driver: Commercial and store growth scale efficiently, gross margin stabilizes and working-capital support remains durable. / 商业客户与门店增长有效形成规模效应，毛利率企稳且营运资金支持保持可持续。
scenarios.falsification_trigger: FCF remains below the USD 1.94 billion reverse requirement, gross margin continues to deteriorate or supplier terms shorten. / 若FCF仍低于19.4亿美元反向估值要求、毛利率继续恶化或供应商账期缩短，则Bull情景被推翻。
scenarios.notes: USD 2.00 billion is 22.4573% above the validated base; 30x requires operating proof and stable financing support. / 20亿美元较已验证基准高22.4573%；30倍要求经营改善得到证明且融资支持稳定。

peer_valuation_context.selection_rationale: No period-aligned peer set with consistent FCF definitions was validated. / 尚未验证期间对齐且FCF定义一致的同业集合。
peer_valuation_context.reviewed_by: Codex public-data research QA (human review pending)
peer_valuation_context.interpretation: No peer ranking or peer-derived fair value is permitted. / 不得进行同业自动排名或推导同业公允价值。

source_of_fcf: Positive LTM reported CFO after cash interest, cash taxes and working-capital movements / 正的LTM报告CFO，已包含现金利息、现金税与营运资金变动
Reported cash capex with no unsupported maintenance/growth split / 采用报告现金资本开支，不虚构维持性与增长性拆分
fcf_quality_assessment.sustainability_assessment: FCF is reproducible, but durability depends materially on supplier payment terms, inventory productivity and returns on elevated growth capex. / FCF可复算，但其可持续性实质依赖供应商付款条款、库存效率及较高增长资本开支的回报。
fcf_quality_assessment.conclusion: FCF quality is adequate for scenario construction but not strong enough to assume that the latest negative working-capital structure is permanent. / FCF质量足以用于情景构建，但不足以假设当前负营运资金结构永久持续。

dimensions.dimension: Reported-to-normalized bridge / 报告至标准化桥接
dimensions.implication: No unsupported adjustments or CFO double counting. / 不作无依据调整，也不重复计算CFO项目。

dimensions.dimension: Working-capital support / 营运资金支持
dimensions.assessment: Strong but financing-dependent / 强但依赖融资
dimensions.implication: Negative CCC relies on supplier terms and must be stress-tested. / 负CCC依赖供应商条款，必须进行压力测试。
Growth capex must produce measurable incremental cash returns. / 增长性资本开支必须产生可衡量的增量现金回报。

limitations: No eight-quarter normalized cash-conversion history is validated.
Maintenance and growth capex are not publicly separated.
fcf_quality_assessment.reviewed_by: Codex public-data research QA (human review pending)

investment_decision_summary.current_view: AutoZone has strong operating growth and no immediate public-data refinancing wall, but validated LTM FCF of USD 1.633 billion remains below the USD 1.940 billion required at the selected 25x reference. Supplier-financing dependence, elevated capex and continued buybacks make the risk/reward insufficiently proven for a stronger public-data action. / AutoZone经营增长强劲，公开资料亦未显示即时再融资墙，但已验证LTM FCF为16.33亿美元，仍低于选定25倍参考所需的19.40亿美元；供应商融资依赖、较高资本开支与持续回购使风险回报尚不足以支持更强判断。
what_would_make_attractive: Normalized FCF validates above USD 1.94 billion while accounts-payable-to-inventory and revolver capacity remain stable. / 标准化FCF经验证超过19.4亿美元，同时应付账款占库存比例与循环授信能力保持稳定。
Gross margin stabilizes and commercial/store growth produces cash returns without a material increase in net debt. / 毛利率企稳，商业客户与门店增长产生现金回报，且净债务不显著增加。
what_would_invalidate: Normalized FCF falls below USD 1.30 billion or supplier terms shorten materially without replacement liquidity. / 标准化FCF低于13亿美元，或供应商账期显著缩短且无替代流动性。
Buybacks and capex continue to outpace internally generated cash while leverage or refinancing dependence rises. / 回购与资本开支持续超过内部现金生成，且杠杆或再融资依赖上升。
what_to_monitor_next: Gross margin, commercial same-store sales, inventory growth and payable-to-inventory. / 毛利率、商业客户同店销售、库存增速及应付账款占库存比例。
LTM FCF, capex, actual buybacks, revolver availability and the debt maturity/use-of-proceeds bridge. / LTM FCF、资本开支、实际回购、循环授信可用额及债务到期与募集资金用途桥接。
investment_decision_summary.reviewed_by: Codex public-data research QA (human review pending)

upgrade_conditions: Upgrade valuation confidence if normalized FCF exceeds USD 1.94 billion without weaker liquidity or higher supplier-finance dependence. / 若标准化FCF超过19.4亿美元且流动性不转弱、供应商融资依赖不上升，则上调估值可信度。
Upgrade the operating view if gross margin stabilizes and domestic commercial sales remain positive while inventory growth is controlled. / 若毛利率企稳、美国商业客户销售保持增长且库存增速受控，则上调经营判断。
Upgrade balance-sheet confidence when numerical covenant headroom and the full post-issuance sources-and-uses bridge are reproducible. / 当契约数值余量及票据发行后完整资金来源与用途能够复算时，上调资产负债表可信度。
downgrade_conditions: Downgrade if normalized FCF is below USD 1.50 billion for two comparable periods. / 若标准化FCF连续两个可比期间低于15亿美元，则下调判断。
Downgrade if accounts-payable-to-inventory declines materially while inventory remains elevated. / 若应付账款占库存比例显著下降且库存仍处高位，则下调判断。
Downgrade if buybacks and capex are funded by rising debt without proportional cash-flow growth. / 若回购与资本开支由增加债务提供资金而现金流未同比例增长，则下调判断。
thesis_invalidation_conditions: Invalidate the cash-conversion thesis if supplier-term normalization creates a sustained cash outflow and no alternative liquidity is secured. / 若供应商账期正常化造成持续现金流出且未获得替代流动性，则现金转化逻辑失效。
Invalidate the valuation thesis if FCF remains below USD 1.30 billion while the market continues to price a high multiple. / 若FCF持续低于13亿美元而市场仍给予高倍数，则估值逻辑失效。

Invalidate the no-immediate-credit-constraint conclusion upon material facility loss, covenant breach or inability to refinance near-term obligations on acceptable terms. / 若授信可用额大幅下降、违反契约，或无法以可接受条件再融资近期义务，则“无即时信用约束”结论失效。

catalysts: Normalized FCF exceeding USD 1.94 billion with stable supplier-finance support. / 标准化FCF超过19.4亿美元且供应商融资支持稳定。
Gross-margin stabilization and sustained commercial sales growth. / 毛利率企稳且商业客户销售持续增长。
A reproducible post-note-issuance debt and liquidity bridge. / 可复算的票据发行后债务与流动性桥接。

credit_constraint_status.basis: Reported revolver availability and the completed note issuance do not show an immediate funding wall, but low cash, supplier-finance dependence, numerical covenant headroom and a complete post-issuance sources-and-uses bridge remain important limitations. / 已披露循环授信可用额及已完成票据发行未显示即时融资墙，但低现金、供应商融资依赖、契约数值余量缺失及发行后完整资金来源与用途桥接仍是重要限制。

portfolio_context.note: Portfolio Overlay: Disabled - fund-specific target return, downside tolerance, horizon, current exposure, liquidity, concentration and opportunity cost were not provided. / 组合叠加层未启用：尚未提供基金特定的目标回报、下行容忍度、期限、当前敞口、流动性、集中度及机会成本。
